title: The operating system must prevent the use of dictionary words for passwords.
check_content: Verify the operating system prevents the use of dictionary words for passwords. If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the operating system to prevent the use of dictionary words for passwords.
VulnDiscussion: If the operating system allows the user to select passwords based on dictionary words, then this increases the chances of password compromise by increasing the opportunity for successful guesses and brute-force attacks.
